title: Golden to Red Rocks Half Day Electronic Bike Tour
blurb:
Explore the picturesque landscapes of Colorado on a guided E-bike tour. We'll lead you on quiet roads and bike paths to visit Dinosaur Ridge, Golden, Morrison, and the famous Red Rocks Amphitheater. 

We pedal along the mountains finding beautiful views at every turn. Ice cream awaits half way, and a stop at the world renown Red Rocks Amphitheater museum is always a highlight.

The premium E-bikes allow all level of cyclists to enjoy the ride without exhaustion. With options to be picked up in Denver or meet in Golden, we will make this trip convenient and fun! This tour is perfect for private groups and team building. Return home with a memory you will never forget!
